env.loadPolicy: Read .env before starting MCP servers and export any configured values into the agent process environment. Keep .env ignored; commit only .env.example.

policy.purpose: Project-recommended generic MCP servers for agents working in this repository.
policy.secrets: Never store API keys, PATs, OAuth tokens, or application-default credential files in this repository.
notes: Use these MCPs only when they help the current task.
Keep repository-intelligence MCPs out unless benchmark and security evidence is recorded in docs/agent-context-efficiency-audit.md.

context7.purpose: Fetch current library and framework documentation during coding tasks.

chrome-devtools.purpose: Inspect and automate Chrome DevTools for browser debugging and UI verification.
chrome-devtools.installCommand: codex mcp add chrome-devtools -- npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest

github-readonly.purpose: Read GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and related metadata without write tools.

clients.antigravity: not configured; local Antigravity docs only document stdio and SSE serverUrl transports
clients.agy: not configured; uses Antigravity/Gemini MCP config

auth.secretStorage: Use Codex OAuth/session storage; do not commit tokens.

gcloud.purpose: Use Google Cloud through the local gcloud CLI with the active gcloud identity.

prerequisites: Authenticate with gcloud auth login and application-default credentials when needed.

stitch.purpose: Use Google Stitch design workflows through a local MCP proxy, without Figma.
stitch.installCommand: codex mcp add stitch -- npx -y @_davideast/stitch-mcp proxy

options: Run npx @_davideast/stitch-mcp init for guided setup.
Set STITCH_API_KEY for API key auth only when needed.
Use existing Google Cloud CLI defaults if the proxy requests Google credentials.

stitchPlugins.installCommand: codex plugin marketplace add google-labs-code/stitch-skills --ref main --sparse .agents/plugins --sparse plugins/stitch-design --sparse plugins/stitch-build --sparse plugins/stitch-utilities

verification: Read .env first and export configured values into the shell or Codex environment.
Restart Codex after changing MCP or plugin config.
For Codex CLI verification in this environment, set CODEX_HOME=C:\Users\ianma\.codex before running codex mcp list or plugin list.
Use /mcp in Codex UI to inspect active MCP servers.
Use Additional Options (...) > MCP Servers in Antigravity IDE to inspect active MCP servers.
Use codex mcp get <server-name> to inspect a configured server.
Confirm required environment variables are available before startup.
